about: Investedia company directory. A company is the business; listings are its tradable stocks. Built from markets.json; facts beyond name, country, sector and listings come only from tools/companies-extra.json with sources.

companies.name: 3I
companies.description: 3i Group is a company listed on the London Stock Exchange and based in the United Kingdom. It is named 3I Group in its legal name.

companies.name: A.P. Møller - Mærsk
companies.description: A.P. Møller - Mærsk is a company based in Denmark and listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen. Its business is container shipping and logistics.

companies.name: Absa
companies.description: Absa Group is a financial services company listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange and based in South Africa.

companies.name: Acciones Iberdrola
companies.description: Acciones Iberdrola is a listed share associated with Iberdrola, a company based in Spain and traded on the Bolsa de Madrid.

companies.name: Acs,Actividades De Construccion
companies.description: Acs, Actividades de Construccion is a company listed on the Bolsa de Madrid in Spain. Its name indicates a construction business.

companies.name: ACWA POWER
companies.description: ACWA Power is a company listed on the Saudi Exchange, legally named ACWA POWER Co, and based in Saudi Arabia.

companies.name: adidas
companies.description: Adidas is a company based in Germany and listed on the Xetra stock exchange. It is known as a maker of sportswear and athletic footwear.

companies.name: Advanc_Advanced Info Service
companies.description: Advanced Info Service is a company listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand and based in Thailand. It operates in the telecommunications sector.

companies.name: Advanced Micro Devices
companies.description: Advanced Micro Devices is a United States-based company listed on a US exchange. It is generally known as a designer of semiconductors and processors.

companies.name: Aena, S.M.E
companies.description: Aena, S.M.E. is a company listed on the Bolsa de Madrid in Spain. Based on the given facts, it is classified under industrials and airport operations.

companies.name: Air Liquide
companies.description: Air Liquide is a company based in France and listed on Euronext Paris. It is generally known as a supplier of industrial and medical gases.

companies.name: Airbus
companies.description: Airbus is a company based in France. It has a US listing and is classified under the industrials sector.

companies.name: Airports of Thailand
companies.description: Airports of Thailand is a company based in Thailand and listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. It operates airports.

companies.name: Al Rajhi Bank
companies.description: Al Rajhi Bank is a bank based in Saudi Arabia. It is listed on a US exchange.

companies.name: Alcon
companies.description: Alcon is a company based in Switzerland and listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange. It is an eye care business.

companies.name: Alimentation Couche-Tard
companies.description: Alimentation Couche-Tard is a Canada-based company listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange. Its business is operating convenience stores and fuel retail, based on general knowledge of the company.

companies.name: Alinma Bank
companies.description: Alinma Bank is a bank based in Saudi Arabia and listed on the Saudi Exchange.

companies.name: Allegro.Eu
companies.description: Allegro.eu is a company listed on the Warsaw stock exchange and based in Poland. It operates in the online marketplace space.

companies.name: Alpha Bank
companies.description: Alpha Bank is a bank based in Greece.

companies.name: Alphabet
companies.description: Alphabet is the holding company of Google. Most of its revenue comes from advertising on Google Search and YouTube. It also sells cloud computing through Google Cloud, subscriptions, apps and devices, and funds longer-term businesses such as Waymo.
